2609.08391.title: From Coordinates to Candidate Regions: Temporal Change Localization via Region Selection in Remote Sensing Multimodal LLMs
2609.08391.paper_summary: Remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS-MLLMs) have advanced scene understanding and visual question answering over satellite imagery, yet localizing specific objects or changed regions remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on generating bounding box coordinates as token sequences, which is fragile for the small, densely packed objects common in remote sensing and increasingly error-prone when multiple targets must be localized simultaneously. In this work, we present an RS-specific formulation of the region selection paradigm, previously explored in natural-image MLLMs, and extend it to temporal change localization over multi-image sequences. Our framework employs a text-conditioned region proposal module, encodes each candidate as special tokens carrying per-frame visual features enriched with spatial and temporal cues, and lets the LLM localize targets by selecting region tokens in its response. We construct a multi-task training and evaluation suite spanning localization, referring expression, visual grounding, and understanding tasks across single-image and multi-temporal settings. Experiments show that our approach substantially outperforms coordinate-generation baselines on temporal change localization, while improving single-image visual grounding and maintaining competitive understanding performance. Oracle analysis decomposes the contributions of the region proposer and the LLM selector, providing diagnostic insight unique to this framework. Our code will be available at https://github.com/juwan-kr/RS-RegionSelect.
2609.08391.paper_summary_zh: 遙感多模態大型語言模型（RS-MLLMs）已經提升了對衛星影像的場景理解和視覺問題回答能力，但定位特定物體或變化區域仍然具有挑戰性。現有的方法依賴於生成邊界框坐標作為標記序列，這對於遙感中常見的小型密集物體來說是脆弱的，並且在必須同時定位多個目標時，錯誤率會增加。在這項工作中，我們提出了一種針對RS的區域選擇範式的特定公式，這一範式之前已在自然影像的MLLMs中探索，並將其擴展到多影像序列的時間變化定位。我們的框架採用文本條件的區域提議模塊，將每個候選者編碼為攜帶每幀視覺特徵的特殊標記，這些特徵融合了空間和時間線索，並讓LLM通過在其回應中選擇區域標記來定位目標。我們構建了一個涵蓋定位、參考表達、視覺基礎和理解任務的多任務訓練和評估套件，涵蓋單影像和多時間設定。實驗顯示，我們的方法在時間變化定位上顯著優於坐標生成基線，同時改善了單影像視覺基礎並保持競爭力的理解性能。Oracle分析分解了區域提議者和LLM選擇者的貢獻，提供了該框架獨特的診斷見解。我們的代碼將在 https://github.com/juwan-kr/RS-RegionSelect 上提供。
